villager: Villager: The eastern trail changed again. It used to curve beside the birch tree.
Tavi: I marked it yesterday. I'll check the markers when the festival is over.
sign: BRACKENREACH — Lantern Wake tonight. Eastern trail beyond the old shelter.
Tavi: A familiar sign. Let's hope the path still agrees with it.
hearth: Tavi: They say the Hearthlight's glow keeps the old paths from changing.
Villager: Before the festival, could you shift that handcart at the outer bridge? Come back when you're done.
mapbook: Tavi: A map is useful only while someone checks the trail.
cart: Villager: Thank you. You always know where a path ought to lead.
Tavi: Only because I keep checking.
The bridge is clear. Return to the Hearthlight in the square.
failure: Tavi: The Hearthlight… it's gone out. Those roots weren't here a moment ago.
Something is struggling beneath the fallen beam by the hollow tree. I can help.
rescue: Tavi: Hold still. I'll lift this end.
The little root-creature slips free. Three slow taps. A pause. Two quick taps.
Tavi: Mote. That suits you. Stay close.
weapon: Tavi: A practice blade from the festival stand. Better than bare hands.
Thornlings are coming out of that root bed. Watch for their wind-up, then strike with J / X / SWORD.
Watch the green health bar beneath your lives. Each hit reduces health; an empty bar costs one heart and refills. Different enemies strike with different strength.
combat_done: Tavi: The lane is clear. Come on, Mote. Rusk will be at the old shelter.
rusk: Rusk: The paths are moving. If the Anchors fail, we may lose every safe road. Take this worn trail-warden's sword and mapbook.
Tavi: Then tell me where to start.
Rusk: Follow its markings to the first root-temple. Bring back whatever still answers the light. If the old stories are wrong, come back with something better.
exit_locked: Tavi: I need to finish helping here before I leave. Follow the objective above.
